visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a red and white striped shirt kneels on a light wood floor, opening a large brown cardboard box with the brand name 'VEVOR' printed on it. (2) A man in a red t-shirt and red socks unfolds the legs of a portable white folding table in a living room with a green sofa. (3) The man spreads a green tablecloth over the table while the woman cuts open a smaller box filled with mahjong tiles. (4) The woman speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her hands while two young children stand nearby in a bright, modern living room. (5) A young child in a red shirt points at mahjong tiles on the table, learning the characters and numbers as the woman guides him. (6) Another younger child sits on a red inflatable seat, making a 'six' hand gesture while looking at a mahjong tile held by the woman. (7) A montage shows the children identifying different tiles including 'East, South, West, North' with high-energy expressions. (8) The woman and the older child sit on small stools across from each other at the green table, playing a full game of mahjong with tiles lined up. (9) The woman smiles and celebrates as she draws a winning tile, showing it to the camera while the child watches. (10) A young girl with pigtails in a red dress pushes over a small tower of tiles, laughing, while the younger boy smiles nearby.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator (Yun), 1 adult male, 4 children (Stel, Giorgie, and twin girls).
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main character is a woman with her hair in a bun, initially wearing a red/white striped pajama-style shirt, later changing into a white knitted sweater and brown skirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern, bright indoor living room with light wooden floors, a large green modular sofa, white cabinetry, a TV on the wall, and various children's toys and books on shelves.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Rapid acoustic guitar strumming begins with high-tempo percussion. Sounds of heavy cardboard sliding on the floor and tape being ripped are clear. (2) Sharp metallic clangs and clicks occur as the table legs lock into place. A female voice speaks with high energy and rapid articulation. (3) The rhythmic clacking of mahjong tiles spilling onto a surface creates a dense, percussive soundscape. The BGM remains bright and consistent. (4) Vocals shift between the adult female and high-pitched children's voices. Short 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects punctuate successful identification of tiles. (5) Continuous mid-frequency clacking of tiles being shuffled and moved. Laughter and excited vocal outbursts from children are layered over the acoustic music. (6) A sudden louder comedic 'slide' sound effect occurs as tiles are pushed over, followed by a final celebratory cheer from the children.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Preparation -> Tutorial -> Engagement -> Climax/Win -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document a family's Lunar New Year tradition of teaching young children how to play mahjong, highlighting the children's progress and the joyful domestic atmosphere.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: A prominent VEVOR-branded box is shown at the very beginning of the video, and the mahjong table/set from the brand is the central object of the video's activity.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-energy family vlog with fast-paced editing and heavy use of variety-show style captions. The focus is on early childhood education through traditional games.
